question: Does --height 1080 cost accuracy on the SoccerTrack panorama, given that it does not speed up detection?
method: same track_live settings (rfdetr_mixed_small, tiles 4, track-fps 15, static camera); 1080p = live rehearsal 990601 (landmark calibration scaled to 2176x1080), 4K = 990612 (same source segments, 3840x1906, landmark calibration); eval_telestration --reference-default, 600-960 s, 1500 frames
verdict: on this panorama 1080p loses 7.3 points of drawn frames and some accuracy for no detection speed-up; keep native resolution. The earlier '1080p is free' result came from a TeamTrack drone clip and does not transfer.
limits: one window of one match; segment boundaries differ slightly (copy vs re-encode)
